_comment: Pairs the corpus explicitly warns are DIFFERENT PEOPLE. R05 raises an error if any of these are merged or cross-referenced as one, and the alias matcher is tested against every pair as a negative. Never auto-merge; two men named Ameziane are the reason.

pairs.why: Different Middle Atlas resistance leaders. Routinely conflated because the folded forms are close.
Mohamed Ameziane died 1912 leading Rif resistance against Spain. Mohammed Sellam Ameziane directed the 1958-59 Rif revolt against the independent Moroccan government. Half a century apart.

neverMerge.name: Sidi Mohamed Ben Hammou
neverMerge.why: Identification deliberately unresolved in the corpus. Any merge or confident resolution is an error, not an improvement.
